name: Apollo Router
description: A configurable, high-performance routing runtime for Apollo Federation

directives-on-directives.note: Implemented in apollo-compiler `2.0.0-beta.2` ([apollo-rs pr](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-rs/pull/1111)). The router `dev-v3.x` branch still uses `2.0.0-beta.1`.

empty-selection-sets.note: Implemented in apollo-compiler `2.0.0-beta.2` ([parser pr](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-rs/pull/1115), [compiler pr](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-rs/pull/1116)). The router `dev-v3.x` branch still uses `2.0.0-beta.1`.

executable-documents-descriptions.note: Merged in the `dev-v3.x` branch with the upgrade to apollo-compiler v2 ([pr](https://github.com/apollographql/router/pull/10119)), available in `v3.0.0-preview.0`, not in a stable release yet. Parsing comes from [apollo-rs](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-rs/pull/974).

graphql-response+json.note: Merged in the `dev-v3.x` branch, not released yet ([pr](https://github.com/apollographql/router/pull/9977))

one-of.note: Merged in the `dev-v3.x` branch, available in `v3.0.0-preview.0`, not in a stable release yet ([pr](https://github.com/apollographql/router/pull/10124)). Stable 2.x releases still use apollo-compiler 1.x, which lacks `@oneOf` ([apollo-rs pr](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-rs/pull/1030)).

persisted-documents.note: The protocol for persisted documents is still TBD
